title: Classic NLP Before LLMs
tagline: The NLP toolkit that came before transformers: tokenizing and normalizing text, TF-IDF, n-grams, Naive Bayes, HMM tagging, NER, topic models, word vectors, and seq2seq with attention.
prereqs: Machine Learning. Deep Learning for the seq2seq and attention steps.

steps.title: What NLP is
steps.why: The main NLP tasks and how a text pipeline fits together.

steps.title: Text tokenization
steps.why: Split raw text into tokens and see why the choices matter.

steps.title: Stemming and lemmatization
steps.why: Reduce words to a shared base form with NLTK and spaCy.

steps.title: TF-IDF
steps.why: Weight word counts by how rare each word is across documents.

steps.title: N-gram language models
steps.why: Predict the next word from counts of the previous few words.

steps.title: Naive Bayes for spam filtering
steps.why: A fast text classifier that assumes words are independent given the class.

steps.title: Sentiment analysis: VADER to RoBERTa
steps.why: Score reviews with a word-list method, then a pretrained model, and compare.

steps.title: Part-of-speech tagging
steps.why: Tag each word's grammatical role with a hidden Markov model.

steps.title: The Viterbi algorithm
steps.why: Find the most likely tag sequence with dynamic programming.

steps.title: Named entity recognition
steps.why: Pull people, places, and organizations out of text with spaCy.

steps.title: Topic modeling with LDA
steps.why: Model each document as a mix of topics, and each topic as a mix of words.

steps.title: Word embeddings and word2vec
steps.why: Learn word vectors by predicting the words around each word.

steps.title: GloVe and fastText
steps.why: Word vectors from co-occurrence counts and from subword pieces.

steps.title: Seq2seq encoder-decoder models
steps.why: Map one sequence to another, as in translation, with two LSTMs.

steps.title: Attention for seq2seq
steps.why: Let the decoder look back at every input word, the step toward transformers.

projects: Build a spam filter with TF-IDF and Naive Bayes, and report precision and recall on a held-out set.
Run LDA on a news or Reddit dataset with gensim and label the top 10 topics by their words.
Train word2vec on a book from Project Gutenberg and show nearest neighbors and analogies.
